_comment: Per-category prompt parts ({w},{h},{ratio} = footprint in tiles) and fit rules for fit_asset.py. fit.mode: footprint = scale the model into its w x h cells (keeps proportions, margin), size = scale so that the model fits max_xz across and max_h high. tris/tex = budget after fitting. flag = add PlayerColor pennant (only if the catalog row has flag=1). back = tiles the model may extend behind (north of) its footprint, as H3 pictures rise behind the blocked front row; {d} in prompts = h + back. align = square the base slab up with the axes (min-area bounding rectangle, turn -45..45). orient = find the facade from the concept (fit_asset.orient_from_concept; facade = image-right face); 0 for symmetric things. lay = tip tall thin items (artifacts) over so they lie on the ground.

_default.view: three-quarter isometric-like view from the front-left: the camera is in front of the subject and about 35 degrees to its left, raised about 35 degrees above the horizon, orthographic look without perspective distortion; the subject's front side (entrance / face) is turned towards the viewer.
_default.base: Base: none; the subject rests on an invisible floor with a flat bottom.

town.size: a whole fortified town as one compact, massive complex of walls, towers and halls; about {w} map tiles wide and {d} tiles deep (width:depth = {ratio}), the tallest towers rising about as high as the complex is deep.
town.base: Base: the town stands on a low rocky plateau whose outline is a rounded rectangle (width:depth = {ratio}); a short road leads up to the main gate in the middle of the front side; the plateau ends in a flat horizontal bottom cut, no loose rocks around it.
town.extra: No banners or flags anywhere (owner flags are added later).

building.size: one building or structure about {w} map tiles wide and {d} tiles deep (width:depth = {ratio}); sturdy proportions, roof and walls clearly separated.
building.base: Base: it stands on a thin flat irregular slab of packed earth with gravel and a few small grass tufts, the slab outline filling a {ratio} (width:depth) rectangle; the slab is very thin and its bottom is flat.
building.extra: No banners or flags (owner flags are added later).

mine.size: a mine about {w} map tiles wide and {d} tiles deep (width:depth = {ratio}): a rock outcrop or hillock with the mine entrance in its front side.
mine.base: Base: the rock outcrop itself forms the base and ends in a flat horizontal bottom cut; a little packed-earth apron in front of the entrance.
mine.extra: No banners or flags (owner flags are added later).

resource.size: a small heap that fits on one map tile: low, compact, about as wide as deep and about half as high as wide.
resource.base: Base: none; the heap sits directly on the invisible floor with a flat bottom.

pickup.size: a small item lying on the ground that fits on one map tile, compact and chunky (drawn larger than life so it reads from far above).
pickup.base: Base: none; it rests directly on the invisible floor with a flat bottom.

tree.size: exactly one single tree, about one map tile wide, with a full crown and a short trunk.
tree.base: Base: none; only the short root flare of the trunk, cut flat at the bottom; no grass patch or ground disc.
tree.extra: Exactly one tree, no other plants, no falling leaves or snowflakes.
tree.view: side view from the front, raised about 20 degrees above the horizon, orthographic look; the whole tree from the root flare to the top of the crown.

bush.size: one small plant group (shrub, cactus, mushrooms, flowers or similar) that fits on one map tile.
bush.base: Base: none; it sits directly on the invisible floor with a flat bottom.

mountain.size: a rocky mountain massif about {w} map tiles wide and {d} tiles deep (width:depth = {ratio}), with several peaks; its height is about half its width.
mountain.base: Base: no separate base; the rock mass itself ends in a flat horizontal bottom cut, its footprint filling a {ratio} rectangle.
mountain.extra: No buildings, no trees, no paths on the mountain.

rock.size: a group of boulders and rock slabs about {w} map tiles wide and {d} tiles deep, low (height about a third of its width).
rock.base: Base: none; the rocks rest on the invisible floor, bottom cut flat.
rock.extra: No plants except a little moss.

landform.size: a natural landform about {w} map tiles wide and {d} tiles deep (width:depth = {ratio}), mostly low and flat.
landform.base: Base: it is shaped on a thin flat slab of natural ground whose outline fills a {ratio} rectangle; flat bottom.

creature.size: one single creature, full body, in a calm ready stance; compact pose with limbs and wings close to the body.
creature.base: Base: none, no pedestal or ground disc; the creature stands on the invisible floor.
creature.extra: Exactly one creature, nothing in the air around it, no magic effects.
creature.view: three-quarter isometric-like view from the front-left: the camera is in front of the creature and about 40 degrees to the left, raised about 30 degrees above the horizon, orthographic look; the creature faces towards the lower right of the picture, so we see its face/front and its left flank.

hero.size: one hero riding a horse, horse and rider as one compact group, the horse walking forward.
hero.base: Base: none, no ground; the horse's hooves rest on the invisible floor.
hero.extra: Exactly one rider on one horse. No flag, no banner, no lance pennant.
hero.view: three-quarter isometric-like view from the front-left: the camera is in front of the rider and about 40 degrees to the left, raised about 30 degrees above the horizon, orthographic look; horse and rider face towards the lower right of the picture, so we see the horse's head and chest and its left flank.

boat.size: one small sailing boat / vessel that fits on about one map tile, chunky proportions.
boat.base: Base: none; the hull is cut flat at the waterline, no water shown.
boat.extra: No crew, no water, no splashes.

water.size: an object floating on or standing in the sea, about {w} map tiles wide and {d} tiles deep.
water.base: Base: none; it is cut flat at the waterline, no water surface shown.
water.extra: No water, waves or splashes in the picture.

portal.size: one magic gateway or monolith about {w} map tiles wide and {d} tiles deep, clearly taller than wide.
portal.base: Base: it stands on a small flat stone platform with a flat bottom.
portal.extra: No glow beyond the gateway itself, no particles.
